$comment: Named voices shown in the UI. 'Ahmed' and 'Akter' are DISPLAY NAMES only. Each maps to a real provider voice per language. provider can be 'piper' (offline, no key, model auto-downloads once), 'elevenlabs' (needs key, best English), 'azure' (needs key+region, best Bangla), or 'browser' (robotic fallback). Edit provider_voice_id then rebuild; swapping a provider here does not change the UI.

bn.$note: community bn Piper model; set provider 'azure' + 'bn-BD-PradeepNeural' with a key for better quality
set provider 'azure' + 'bn-BD-NabanitaNeural' with a key for better quality

voices.$note: Cloned from your reference clip via the local XTTS server (xtts-server/). provider_voice_id = the .wav filename stem in xtts-server/voices/. Start the server (run.bat), set the XTTS URL in settings, then pick 'My Voice' for a slot.

bn.$note: XTTS has no Bangla; this will read bn text with an English model. Use Azure for real Bangla.
